title: fix(spec)!: a record page that places no component is refused at parse, not drawn as a blank detail panel
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiUCGAbyP1FJ1SjFNdxneoxC)_

Fixes #32434

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 一个记录页（`type: 'record'`，也是不写 `type` 时的默认值；`kind: 'full'`）如果在 `regions` 里一个组件都没放，现在在解析时就被拒绝：保存接口回 422，`os validate` / `os build` / `defineStack` 报错，错误信息一句话说明怎么改（放组件、改成 `kind: 'slotted'`、删页，或者写明它本来是 home / app / utility / list 页）。唯一例外：没绑 `object` 但带 `interfaceConfig.source` 的页，控制台把它画成列表，不判。
- **为什么改：** 以前这种页面能保存、能发布、诊断还显示有效，但打开该对象的任何一条记录都只有面包屑和一块空白，AI 作者最常写出的正是这种页面；`regions` 的说明还错误地声称空页面会回落到默认布局。
- **风险与回滚：** 这是一次收窄：首方仓库（examples、平台对象、插件页、hotcrm、gallery）实测 0 个页面受影响。已经存进库里的这类页面照常读出（`_diagnostics.valid: false`），下次保存才被拒；平铺注册的已安装包照常安装；整包交给 manifest 服务的预构建发布产物会整体注册失败，并按路径指出是哪一页（修页面后重新构建即可）。控制台对已存的这类页面仍然画空白，这一点交给 domain:ui。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts` 里的 `checkPageRecordPlacesComponent`，以及 `packages/rest/src/meta-page-record-no-component.test.ts`（真实保存接口上的拒绝与对照）和 `packages/objectql/src/registry-package-record-page-no-component.test.ts`（两个包注册入口）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/page.test.ts`，看「a full record page that places no component is refused」那一组；home / list / slotted 页面和「无 object + interfaceConfig.source」页面不受影响的对照也在同一组。
- **需要你做的：** 无需决策。两处升级问题已由 seat 裁定（见下文 Review rounds）；domain:ui 的两个后续问题（已存空记录页在控制台的回落、`PageKindNodeSchema` 是否挂这条检查）写在下面，由 seat 转交。

## What changes

- `PageSchema` (`@objectstack/spec/ui`) gains `checkPageRecordPlacesComponent`, attached by identifier like its seven siblings. A `kind: 'full'` page whose type is `record` (or absent: `record` is the default type) and whose `regions` place no component (no regions, or only regions with an empty `components` list) is refused at `regions`. Bound to an object, the sentence reads: *"This record page places no component in its `regions`, so every record of its object would open on a blank detail panel: add a region with components (`regions: [{ name: 'main', components: [{ type: 'record:details' }] }]`), make it `kind: 'slotted'` to draw the object's default record page with only the slots you name replaced, or delete the page so the object's default record page draws — and if it is not meant as a record page, name its type (`type` defaults to `record`): `type: 'home'`, `'app'` or `'utility'`, which draw the label as the page heading, or `type: 'list'` with an `interfaceConfig.source`."* Bound to no object, it says the page opens on a blank page, asks to bind its `object` and add a region, and ends with the same type clause.
- Not judged: a record page that binds no `object` and carries a non-blank `interfaceConfig.source`. The page route (`PageView`) draws any page carrying `interfaceConfig.source` as an interface list whatever its type, and no record view selects a page without an object. A page bound to an object is judged whatever `interfaceConfig` it carries, because that object's record view selects it and draws only its regions. Both directions are pinned (seat ruling (a)).
- `definePage`, `defineStack` (so `os validate` / `os build`, `STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID`), the metadata save door (`PUT /api/v1/meta/page/NAME`, `422 INVALID_METADATA`), and the `manifest` service when it is handed a whole release artifact all refuse through the same parse. At the artifact door the refusal names the page by its path (`packages[N]`, `manifest.pages.M.regions`). A pre-built artifact carrying such a page fails registration whole: fix the page and rebuild (seat ruling (b)). A package body registered flat, the way a hosted kernel registers an installed package, meets no page parse and installs as before.
- `home`, `app`, `utility` and `list` pages with no regions still parse; `slotted`, `html` and `react` pages are not judged.
- The `regions` describe, the `page` form note, `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` and `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx` drop the claim that an empty full page "falls back to the synthesized default layout" (the console never did that) and state the rule and its one exemption.
- **In-place fix, same defect class, same file:** the `print` refusal for a `full` page with no regions repeated the same false claim ("draws the synthesized default layout"); its message now says the page authors no block to print.
- ADR-0087: semantic entry `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.page-record-no-component-refused.ts`, no conversion (see measurement 3). Changeset `.changeset/32434-record-page-no-component-refused.md` (`@objectstack/spec` minor, BREAKING accept-set narrowing, FROM/TO, upgrade guide).

**File-surface additions outside `packages/spec`, all test or docs only, all accepted by the seat:**

- `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/spec-object-refinements-7715.test.ts`: the census of `PageSchema`'s object-level checks must list the new check, as not attachable on `PageNodeSchema` (it judges by page `type`, which is the discriminator `'page'` on that node); three controls whose subject is not the page type parse as `home` pages, and the `isDefault` control places one component.
- `ui/packages/react/src/hooks/__tests__/usePageAssignment.declarationOrder-7298.test.tsx` and `usePageAssignment.typeDiscriminator-9674.test.tsx`: each positive control parses a record page through the spec's `PageSchema`; the base fixture now places one component so the control still proves the schema accepts a record page.
- `packages/objectql/src/registry-package-record-page-no-component.test.ts` (new): pins the two `manifest` service doors (whole artifact refused naming the page by path, flat body installs) and a control.
- `packages/metadata/src/serializers/typescript-serializer-annotation.test.ts`: its representative page body `account_home` was left to the record default with no regions; it names `type: 'home'` (CI on the first head found it).
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`: the `regions` comment in the interface listing said "optional" with no exception; it now states the full record page rule and the exemption.
- Record-page fixtures in `packages/{objectql,metadata-protocol,core,lint,cli}` tests place one component, or become `home` pages where the body is not the subject; `protocol.adr0005-org-override-rollback.test.ts` also gains the module-top `import '@objectstack/lint'` that `check:test-source-alias` asks of an edited file.

## Why

The card's page, `{ name: 'leave_request_record', type: 'record', object: 'leave_request', template: 'default' }` with no regions, saved `200` with `_diagnostics.valid: true`, published, and opened every `leave_request` record on a blank detail panel. Deleting the page brought the default detail view back. A full record page draws only what its regions place, so the contract is where this is decided; a renderer-only fallback would keep `valid: true` on a page that does nothing.

## Acceptance — measurements (PM assumptions 1–4)

1. **Which types draw only their regions.** Only `record` (kind `full`). `RecordPageLayout` and every template draw `FlatContent` (nothing) for no regions, the label belongs to the `page:header` block, the description is not drawn. `home` / `app` / `utility` draw their `label` as the page heading (and description) when no `page:header` owns it; `list` draws through `interfaceConfig`. So the refusal keys on `type: 'record'` (absent type included), not on `regions` alone. Confirmed.
2. **"Places nothing".** No region, or every region's `components` empty. On the record route nothing else puts content on a full record page: `slots` are not read on `kind: 'full'`, the record view (`usePageAssignment`, `RecordDetailView`) reads no `interfaceConfig`, there is no header or `placedActions` key on the page, and no template draws fields by itself. On the page route, though, `PageView` draws any page carrying `interfaceConfig.source` as an interface list whatever its type, so a record-typed or untyped page with no `object` and a source is a working list, not a blank page: it is left out of the check. Confirmed, with that exemption.
3. **Stored rows and packages.** The read path serves a refused row unchanged with `_diagnostics.valid: false` and the finding at `regions` (pinned in the rest test), and its next save is refused. No lossless rewrite exists (every rewrite that draws something changes what the page shows), so this follows the unplaced-region precedent (`page-template-closed-region-unplaced-refused`): semantic entry, no conversion. **For domain:ui:** the console does not read `_diagnostics`, so a stored row, or the page of a package body registered flat, still draws the blank panel until it is fixed or deleted; whether the console should fall back to the default record page (or show a refusal panel) for such a page is open. **Packages**, measured in the objectql test: a release artifact handed whole to the `manifest` service is refused at `packages[0]` / `manifest.pages.0.regions` and nothing in it registers; a package body handed flat installs and its page is served unchanged. **Studio** starts a new record page `slotted`. Choosing `full` seeds the synthesized regions, and four paths in the create seed (`anchors.ts`) still return a body with no regions: no `object` chosen, the object fetch returning nothing, the synthesized page having no regions, and the fetch throwing. Each save is now refused `422` with the sentence instead of storing a blank page. "Convert to full page" refuses to write when the synthesized regions are empty. First-party and hotcrm carry no such page (measurement 4).
4. **First-party count.** `examples/**`, `platform-objects`, plugin pages: 63 pages, 13 record pages, **0** refused. hotcrm `origin/main` 235106f: **0**. gallery ddf3393: no pages. Templates: none.

## Verification

Pins: `packages/spec/src/ui/page.test.ts` (refusal cases incl. absent `type`, the unbound variant, a bound page carrying `interfaceConfig.source`, `definePage` throws; controls for home / app / utility / list / slotted / html and for an unbound page with `interfaceConfig.source`, typed and untyped; ledger entry), `object-refinement-check-exports.test.ts` (fixtures for both `interfaceConfig` directions, parity legs), `packages/rest/src/meta-page-record-no-component.test.ts` (real `RestServer`, `saveMetaItem` and SQLite: empty page 422 and nothing stored; one component 200; slotted and home 200; stored legacy row served flagged and refused on resave), `packages/objectql/src/registry-package-record-page-no-component.test.ts` (both `manifest` doors and a control).

Ablation (once, on `a7b75867`): removing `.superRefine(checkPageRecordPlacesComponent)` turns 14 pins red across `page.test.ts` and `object-refinement-check-exports.test.ts` (every refusal row, `definePage`, the parity and bijection legs) while the 353 controls stay green; `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` restored the file to its HEAD blob.

Package suites, each `exit 0` after the fixture moves: the full spec suite (927 files), rest, objectql, lint, metadata, metadata-protocol, metadata-core, core, runtime, cli, plugin-auth, plugin-dev, platform-objects, cloud-connection, service-print, service-i18n, plugin-sharing, plugin-approvals, plugin-audit, driver-sql, service-analytics, mcp, docs, studio, setup, account, example-showcase, example-multi-package; ui: 467 test files that parse a spec schema, 1,488 under Studio's metadata admin and design surface, and 207 across the census, `react/src/hooks` and the metadata-admin previews. The derived gate sweep (`dispatch-gates --ran`), `pnpm lint` and the full dogfood battery on the final head are recorded in the os-dev-report on the card.

## Review rounds

Three rounds by one reviewer, each a `## Contract review` record on this PR: round 1 FAIL on `a7b75867` (comment 6808022421, brief 6808037170), round 2 PASS with nits on `76893502` (6808313311), round 3 PASS on the final head `bf5e6e03` (6808336169). Seat rulings on the two escalations: (a) keep the exemption as built, a bound page is refused whatever `interfaceConfig` it carries, both directions pinned; (b) the whole-artifact refusal is intended, it names the page by path, and the changeset and entry say a pre-built artifact fails whole and is fixed by fixing the page and rebuilding. Accepted deviation: a whitespace-only `interfaceConfig.source` is refused (round 2 nit 8).
